response: Treat the plan as four separate, sequential work units. Dispatch a fresh implementer for each task and run its task-scoped combined spec-and-quality review immediately after that implementation, before dispatching the next task. Tasks 1-3 each stay as their own work unit even though the wording replacement is identical, because the baseline workflow says one task per implementer dispatch and never permits parallel implementation dispatches; use the mechanical implementer role and a proportionate reviewer for each. Task 4 is also one work unit, but its concurrent funds reservation and idempotency-key behavior require the deep/high-judgment implementer and a risk-matched reviewer. After all four task reviews pass, run the mandatory broad whole-branch review with the most capable reviewer. Assuming clean reviews, there are no fix rounds and no human stops.
